basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Vancouver, Canada. I've been diving deep into Genshin Impact since its release, and I enjoy sharing tips and strategies with newer players. Outside of gaming, I work as a freelance web developer and occasionally tutor students in coding and computer science. I'm in a long-term relationship and spend my evenings gaming or exploring the latest tech trends. My online hours are typically in the late evening and weekend afternoons.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a degree from a reputable university. My expertise in gaming comes from years of playing and studying games as a hobby. My interest in technology is both professional and personal, as I frequently explore new software and hardware for work and leisure.
